title: TubeRMC: Tube-conditioned Reconstruction with Mutual Constraints for Weakly-supervised Spatio-Temporal Video Grounding
venue: Proceedings of the AAAI Conference on Artificial Intelligence

problems.name: Spatio-Temporal and Object/Event-Level Grounding
problems.evidence_sentence: TubeRMC: Tube-conditioned Reconstruction with Mutual Constraints for Weakly-supervised Spatio-Temporal Video Grounding Spatio-Temporal Video Grounding (STVG) aims to localize a spatio-temporal tube that corresponds to a given language query in an untrimmed video.

problems.name: Annotation Scarcity and Noisy Supervision
problems.evidence_sentence: Recent works have explored weakly-supervised setting in STVG to eliminate reliance on fine-grained annotations like bounding boxes or temporal stamps.

problems.name: Cross-Modal Semantic Alignment Gap
problems.evidence_sentence: This is a challenging task since it involves complex vision-language understanding and spatiotemporal reasoning.

methods.name: Coarse-to-Fine or Hierarchical Localization
methods.evidence_sentence: To address this limitation, we propose a Tube-conditioned Reconstruction with Mutual Constraints (\textbf{TubeRMC}) framework that generates text-conditioned candidate tubes with pre-trained visual grounding models and further refine them via tube-conditioned reconstruction with spatio-temporal constraints.

methods.name: Transformer/DETR-Style Proposal Decoding
methods.evidence_sentence: In this way, the model learns to capture the tube-text correspondences by selecting the best tube proposal to reconstruct the text.
